[Issue #8437] Add organization details to saved opportunity endpoint (#8823)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes / Work for #8437  

## Changes proposed

- Updated get_saved_opportunities endpoint to include a new property
saved_to_organizations in the opportunity response.
- saved_to_organizations contains all organizations (that the user is a
member of) which have saved the opportunity.
- Behavior:
   - User-only saved opportunities: saved_to_organizations is omitted.
- Organization saved opportunities (specific orgs or all saved
opportunities): saved_to_organizations is included.
- If no org has saved it, it returns an empty list [].

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->

The saved_to_organizations field helps frontends distinguish between
user-only saved opportunities and organization-saved opportunities.

head_commit.message: [Issue #7027] FieldList widget plumbing (#8755) ## Summary Work for #7027 This PR introduces initial support for a new UI schema node type, fieldList, as groundwork for the FieldList (formerly ExpandableGroup) feature. ### Changes proposed - Adds fieldList to UI schema validation (AJV schema) - Extends apply-form types to represent UiSchemaFieldList - Updates utilities to treat fieldList similarly to section where applicable: - print widget mapping - warning tree traversal - Adds a getFieldConfig branch for fieldList that builds a FieldList widget config: - Generates a groupDefinition describing the template fields for each list entry - Extracts reusable widget props into generalProps (including schema) - Strips instance-specific props (id, value, key) - Generates a baseId placeholder pattern (`[~~index~~]`) for list row instances - Adds validation guardrails ensuring fieldList children are limited to field/multiField nodes - Updates and extends tests to cover the new node type and ensure existing behavior remains unchanged ### Context for reviewers Some target forms require dynamically sized arrays of grouped fields (e.g., contact lists). The tech spec proposes introducing a fieldList UI schema node that defines a repeatable group template. This PR focuses on the plumbing required for the form system to recognize and configure this node type without affecting existing forms. Specifically, this PR introduces the schema/type support and configuration generation needed so a future FieldList widget can render repeatable rows of fields. ### Scope - No implementation of dynamic add/remove entry behavior yet - No runtime index substitution logic for the `[~~index~~]` placeholder yet - No error-mapping/filtering logic specific to field groups yet (rawErrors currently passed through as empty) - fieldList children are currently restricted to field/multiField nodes; nested fieldList structures are not supported at this time - No changes to existing form JSON fixtures (SF424 / SF424A / SFLLL / NEH cover sheet) beyond ensuring they continue to validate/render ### Implementation notes - groupDefinition represents the template for fields inside each list row - generalProps contains reusable widget configuration derived from existing widget configs - Instance-specific props (id, value, key) are removed so rows can generate their own values - baseId includes a placeholder (`[~~index~~]`) that future work will replace with the actual row index FieldList rows are generated from a template defined in `groupDefinition`. Each entry in `groupDefinition` represents a field that should appear inside a single row of the list and contains: - `widget`: the widget type determined using existing `getFieldConfig` logic - `baseId`: a placeholder-based ID pattern that will be used to generate per-row IDs - `generalProps`: reusable widget configuration (including `schema`, validation constraints, and options) Example structure produced by `getFieldConfig`: FieldList -groupDefinition widget: "Text" baseId: `"contacts[~~index~~]--firstName"` generalProps: schema: {...} required: false disabled: false widget: "AttachmentArray" baseId: `"contacts[~~index~~]--docs"` generalProps: schema: {...} Instance-specific props (`id`, `value`, `key`) are intentionally stripped out so each rendered row can generate its own values using the `baseId` pattern. ### Validation steps `npm run test` Confirmed: - utils.test.ts passes - validate.test.ts passes - getFieldConfig.test.ts passes Manual / Smoke Load apply form pages for: - SF 424 - SF 424A - SF LLL - NEH Cover Sheet Confirm: - Existing widgets render normally (Select, MultiSelect, Attachment, AttachmentArray, Budget widgets) - No console errors related to UI schema parsing or validation

before any training deploys begin.

3. Training API (waits for ALL prod to complete)
4. Training Frontend + Training Analytics (parallel)

If any prod deploy fails, all training deploys are automatically skipped
via the dependency chain.

For `workflow_dispatch` with a single environment, behavior is unchanged
— only that environment is deployed.

## Changes

- Removed matrix strategy from deploy jobs (was `["prod", "training"]`
with `max-parallel: 1`)
- Phase 2 jobs deploy to prod (or selected env for `workflow_dispatch`)
- Added Phase 3 jobs for training that only run on `release` events and
depend on all Phase 2 jobs completing
- Updated slack notification `needs` to include training deploy jobs

## Test plan

- [ ] `workflow_dispatch` to staging deploys all services to staging
only (training jobs skipped)
- [ ] Release deploy runs prod API → prod FE + prod Analytics → training
API → training FE + training Analytics
- [ ] If a prod deploy fails, training deploys are skipped
